digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and timezone-aware datetime handling
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families are not currently enabled in the global linter configuration, allowing drift diagnostics across src/rebar and test files to accumulate.

Current origin/main reports exactly 6 live ASYNC/DTZ diagnostics: 3 in source (validate_checks.py DTZ006/DTZ007, security_pin.py DTZ011) and 3 in tests (test_jira_onboard.py DTZ001, test_review_bot.py ASYNC110/ASYNC251) that must all be resolved before the ratchet lands.

Timestamp validation in validate_checks.py uses timezone-naive datetime calls; integer epoch seconds and persisted timezone-less strings must be explicitly assigned UTC semantics with datetime.timezone.utc.
Security-pin cadence logic must preserve host-local calendar-date semantics while obtaining an aware current instant with an explicit timezone argument, complying with DTZ005.

Test infrastructure must separately assert ASYNC and DTZ selection, verify no security selector S or Semgrep config exists, forbid the datetime.UTC token from src/rebar, and prove timezone invariance under multiple TZ environment values on POSIX/macOS platforms.
